sections.chapter_title: Ethernet (ETH): media access control (MAC) with DMA controller
sections.text_helper: Section 48.9 "Ethernet programming model" in chapter 48 (Ethernet (ETH): media access control (MAC) with DMA controller), RM0522 Rev 1, page 2233.
sections.section_content:
This chapter provides the instructions for initializing the DMA or MAC registers in the proper
sequence. It contains the following sections:
• DMA initialization (see Section48.9.1)
• MTL initialization (see Section48.9.2)
• MAC initialization (see Section48.9.3)
• Performing normal receive and transmit operation (see Section48.9.4)
• Stopping and starting transmission (see Section48.9.5)
• Programming guidelines for MII link state transitions (see Section48.9.8)
• Programming guidelines for IEEE 1588 timestamping (see Section48.9.9)
• Programming guidelines for energy-efficient Ethernet (see Section48.9.11)
• Programming guidelines for flexible pulse-per-second (PPS) output (see
Section48.9.12)
• Programming guidelines for IEEE 1588 auxiliary snapshot (see Section48.9.13)
• Programming guidelines for TSO (see Section48.9.14)
• Programming guidelines for VLAN filtering on the receiver (see Section48.9.15)
• Programming guidelines for receive idle and receive interrupt watchdog timers (see
Section48.9.16)
